# anomaly_chatops_channel (Data Source)

Looks up a ChatOps channel by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing object. Alternatively, supply id instead of name.
data "anomaly_chatops_channel" "example" {
  name = "ops-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `commands_enabled` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String)
- `external_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `notifications_enabled` (Boolean)
- `platform` (String)
- `team_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive)
